results.title: Subway Series
results.overview: A pair of best friends watch a New York World Series together. One is a Mets fan, one is a Yankees fan.  Will the rivalry between their fanbases get in the way of their friendship?

results.title: Whispering Spirit
results.overview: A small family, lacking sufficient financial means, is forced to purchase a house that local residents whisper is haunted by strange supernatural phenomena. How will the family confront a home said to have had many previous owners and a dark, mysterious past?

results.title: Sunlight
results.overview: Disappearing into a monkey costume and creating a new persona, Jane strives to break free from a toxic relationship when she encounters a suicidal radio show host, Roy, who presents a path to freedom. After hitting the open road in Roy's Airstream, the unlikely duo soon hatch a plan that could help finance a new life, but could also land them in jail. Hot on their heels is Jane's controlling partner, Wade, who aims to put an end to Jane's newfound freedom.

results.title: Bea
results.overview: As an immigrant from Venezuela, a young woman named Bea learns to deal with the lingering effects of the world she left behind while discovering hopes for a new life in Paris.

results.title: Pītiti
results.overview: When a boy from a broken home steals a peach from his neighbour's tree, he sets off a clash that will change him forever.

results.title: Stardom in Fuji 2025 Dec.
results.overview: Stardom in Fuji 2025 Dec. was a professional wrestling event produced by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on December 13, 2025, at Fujisan Messe in Fuji, Shizuoka, Japan.

results.overview: Roger Vadim's "... And God created Woman" with Brigitte Bardot, summarised in one minute by Marie Le Puil.

results.title: Last Knife
results.overview: Shelby is one knife set sale away from the vacation of her dreams, if her fantasies don’t get in the way.

results.title: Hollywood Grit
results.overview: When his daughter vanishes from a Hollywood jazz club, a detective must battle mobsters, starlets, and his own demons to unearth the sinister truth lurking behind LA's neon lights.

results.title: Tharae The Exorcist
results.overview: When a vengeful demon resurfaces in Thailand's largest Catholic village, a rigid priest and a maverick shaman must set aside their differences to confront an evil that defies both faith and folklore.

results.title: Estrella, cometa, satélite y planeta
results.overview: A documentary celebrating the life of Fernando Estrella, a pioneering LGBTI activist and beloved cultural icon. Through testimonies from friends and collaborators, it traces his fearless advocacy, artistic brilliance, and deep impact on queer visibility in Spain—from the Movida Madrileña to his influential presence in Palma. A chef, performer, and actor in Almodóvar’s films, Estrella defied norms and built community, especially through his legendary restaurant, Flexa. The film culminates in the surreal and moving farewell party held just before his death in 2023, a testament to the love he inspired.

results.title: Mathru
results.overview: A town is rattled by serial kidnappings each marked by a cryptic code. Vijay haunted by strange dreams, becomes a suspect when the same code is found on his phone. But when his girlfriend and then he himself go missing the truth begins to unfeld Victims are being brainwashed by a mysterious system to worship an unknown idel Whos behind it and why?

results.title: Falling in Love in Niagara
results.overview: After her fiancé leaves her before their wedding, Madeline goes to Niagara Falls to honeymoon without him. There, she reconnects with her adventurous side, learns to let go, and finds new love.

results.title: Leur existence
results.overview: In the city, atop a mountain, and out in space, amateur radio operators wander through the airwaves in search of human connections.

results.title: Весёлая жизнь
results.overview: Marinka and Kolka's provincial wedding takes place in a roadside cafe, where the newlyweds were only able to rent half the room. The reason for this is an expensive wedding ring. The second half of the room is unexpectedly occupied by a wake. The party does not go according to plan, the bride unsuccessfully tries to make perfect content for social networks and takes out all her indignation on the quiet groom. The offended groom puts the wedding ring on the line in a competition. The offended bride runs away from her own wedding with a widower from the wake, who turns out to be a rapist.

results.title: Stone Cold Fox
results.overview: In this '80s-set revenge story, the defiant Fox breaks out of an abusive commune in search of her family. But when the queenpin kidnaps her little sister and sends a crooked cop after her, Fox has no choice but to infiltrate the very place she escaped.

results.title: Stans
results.overview: A revealing, edgy, and disarmingly personal journey into the world of superfandom, told through the lens of one of the world's most iconic and enduring artists, Eminem, and the fans that worship him.

results.title: Church Swine
results.overview: Janice.Click presents Church Swine. The second part of the Pigman saga. Church Swine follows three missionaries as they try and recruit new members to join their church. Carl, the newest member struggles to follow the new rules he has been blessed with. Will Carl make it in this new church or will his own desires get in the way?
